figures.label: Fig. 4
figures.caption: Fig. 4. Power dissipation versus oversampling ratio for a double-sampled first integrator.

references.sentence: Fig. 4.
Fig. 4 plots the power dissipated in a double-sampled first integrator as a function of the oversampling ratio.

From the plot depicted in Fig. 4, it can be concluded that the double-sampling technique achieves twice the Nyquist conversion rate at the cost of only a slight increase in power dissipation, due to the additional loading caused by the sampling operation of the next integrator stage, and without lowering the oversampling ratio.
Based on the results presented in Fig. 4, double-sampled integrators have been used in the experimental prototype implemented in this work.
